summary: Alarum Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release from July 3, 2026, updating that certain domains of its subsidiary NetNut Ltd. were seized by the FBI. The company is experiencing service disruptions that could have a material adverse effect but has not been formally contacted by law enforcement. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic transactions are announced. This is a routine disclosure of an operational incident, not a special-situation category filing.
